# Voicenotes

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 5 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Warm-paper meeting-notes marketing: cream page, ink filled pills, Mackinac and Instrument Serif headlines, Inter controls, a 16px login card and 4px pricing cards.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Login modal opened. Email and password fields were not submitted.. Themes: light.

Voicenotes is an AI meeting-notes product. This package records the public marketing site and the signed-out login modal on voicenotes.com, measured on 19 November 2026. No account was created. Themes seen live: light only. Viewport read: 1169 by 731, devicePixelRatio 2.

## Typography

10 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: InstrumentSerif-Regular, Inter, Inter Medium, Inter Regular, P22 Mackinac Pro.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Marketing `@font-face` files, served from `/_nuxt/`: Inter Regular, Light, Medium, Bold, Black, SemiBold (ttf); Instrument Serif Regular and Italic (ttf); P22 Mackinac Pro Medium and Book (otf). These files were not copied into the package.

The blog names `"P22 Mackinac Pro"` with a Georgia fallback, and `Inter` with a system-ui fallback. The style guide uses those fallbacks. P22 Mackinac and the self-hosted Inter files are the product's fonts. Do not ship the font files.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The home h1 class asks for 60px. At 1169px the computed size is 48px / 56px / -1.4px. Use the computed size for this width.

Inter on the marketing site is a set of separate families (`Inter Regular`, `Inter Medium`, `Inter SemiBold`), each with computed `font-weight: 400`. The blog uses a single `Inter` family and a real weight of 500 on post titles. The tokens keep both.

Dark colours in the stylesheet (`darkTheme2` `#272829`, `greyEE` `#EEEEEE`) were not computed on a live element. They are not in `tokens.json`.

A demo-card box-shadow was truncated in the reading and is not a token.

The login Continue button computed to `rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.85)` while the rule `.tw-dark-btn-rounded-2xl` sets `#0D0D0D` and the hover rule sets the 85% value. The token uses the declared default.

There are no screenshots. Layout claims that need a picture are gaps.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

**Ink on warm paper.** The page is `#FAF9F5` and the text and the filled button are the same `#0D0D0D`. See the home readings in [raw/computed.json](raw/computed.json).

**Serif for the promise, Inter for the control.** Headings use P22 Mackinac or Instrument Serif. Buttons, fields and nav use Inter. See [components.md](components.md).

**Pills for actions, 16px for the login card, 4px for a price card.** Do not give the pricing cards the login radius. See [patterns.md](patterns.md).

**Stop at the password field.** The email step asks for a password. Do not submit it, and do not continue into Google, Apple, Microsoft, Twitter or SSO.
